data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'Noach' meaning 'rest' or 'comfort.' In the biblical story, Noach was a righteous man who built an ark to save his family and pairs of animals from the Great Flood. The name Noach carries the meaning “Rest, Comfort, Consolation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Noach usually hope their child will grow to embody rest, comfort, consolation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
